title: Rav Chaviva son of Rav Yosef son of Rava
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Batra 143b, reporting Rava. Hyman identifies Nanai, mentioned in Yevamot 66b, as his brother.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Yevamot 66b names Nanai son of Rav Yosef son of Rava. The inference that Nanai and Chaviva were brothers is Hyman’s; the cited paragraph does not itself state that relationship.

The whole Davidson Bava Batra 143b paragraph names Rav Chaviva son of Rav Yosef son of Rava reporting Rava; Yevamot 66b names Nanai son of Rav Yosef son of Rava. The local full titles and reporting direction are supported. The brother relationship remains Hyman’s inference, as the current mixed note states verbatim; matching patronymics alone are not a new genealogy binding.
